newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears 39 mining investment proposals.
newsitem.headline: India clears 39 mining investment proposals.

text.p: The Indian government had so far cleared 39 foreign investment proposals in the mining sector, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.

PTI quoted the Mines Minister Birendra Prasad Baishya as saying that of the 39 proposals cleared by the United Front government, 12 were from Australia and the remaining from South Africa and other countries.
The minister said the proposals related to joint ventures and consultancy in the mining and minerals sector.

Baishya said the ministry will hold a two day meeting of state mining ministers later this week to discuss fresh guidelines on allowing large areas for mining and streamlining procedures for granting prospecting licences to private firms.
